desc: Read input values $N, M, S_x, S_y$ and the list of house coordinates, then read the sequence of moves $(D_i, C_i)$.
Organize the house data into four dictionaries (`houses_x`, `houses_y`, `houses_y_to_x`, `houses_x_to_y`) to allow $O(\log N)$ or $O(1)$ lookups for houses on specific lines.
Initialize the current position $(curr\_x, curr\_y)$ to $(S_x, S_y)$ and an empty set `visited_houses` to track unique houses encountered.
Implement the DSU optimization logic for skipping visited houses on lines.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Check for potential edge cases (e.g., no houses on a line, moves that don't pass any houses, large coordinates).
Ensure the output format matches exactly (space-separated integers).
